notes.title: Dev Diary #20
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We are pleased to present a new issue of the "Developers' Diary"!

For everyone eager to learn about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of Singoru in the near future, we are ready to lift the veil of secrecy. In this issue, we will talk about a new game mechanic, a new permanent mode.

[h2]New Mechanic: Summoning Minions![/h2]

Get ready to meet one of the most large-scale and exciting mechanics that will fundamentally change the approach to strategy and tactics in the world of Singoru. Prepare to encounter a new force on the battlefield—minions! This mechanic will not only add depth to the gameplay but also open up new horizons for experimenting and combining your heroes' abilities in battle.

Coming soon to the game:
[list]
[*] Skeleton Warriors;
[*] Stone Golems;
[*] Air Elementals.
[/list]
[h3]Air Elemental and Its Evolutions[/h3]

Air Elementals will be among the first minions that the heroes of Singoru can summon to their aid:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/448f0720d59c42b55d3f0f06205a6cb850ca6b32.png[/img]
Isn't it adorable? However, don't be fooled by its appearance—this new companion will be very useful in battle! And by obtaining the necessary skills for its evolution, you can gain a truly powerful minion:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/6fa301c778923fb121ad2095e526256fd7c3915a.png[/img]

[h3]New Hero Type: Summoners[/h3]

With the introduction of the summoning mechanic, we plan to create a new hero type—Summoners, which means a new skill tree will appear in the Academy! These heroes will specialize in managing summons, enhancing them, and using them tactically.

To develop summoning-related abilities in the Academy, new runes will be added, which can be obtained by participating in matches. These runes will unlock unique upgrades and abilities for your heroes.

[h3]Passive Skills and Synergy with Existing Abilities[/h3]

But that's not all! Along with the new mechanic and new active abilities, passive skills will also appear in the game, which will enhance summoned creatures.
Additionally, some of the already familiar abilities will also interact with summons. For example, the Avatar of Darkness will now strengthen undead, making them even more formidable. Thus, the entire line of avatars will provide bonuses to summoned creatures of the same element.

[h3]Future Plans[/h3]

We don't plan to stop at three heroes and their abilities. In future updates, you can expect:
[list]
[*] New abilities that will open even more possibilities for combinations with summons.
[*] New heroes, each offering a unique playstyle.
[*] New weapons specifically designed to enhance summoners and their creatures.
[/list]
The summoning mechanic is not just an innovation—it's a new stage in the game's development. We strive to make the game even more diverse, strategically deep, and engaging. Prepare for your arsenal of tactics and strategies to expand significantly, and for each match to become even more dynamic and unpredictable.

[h2]New Mode: Chase[/h2]

We are preparing a series of new challenges for you—location modes. Similar to the already beloved Hardcore mode, new activities will gradually be introduced into the game. Each mode will specialize in a specific type of resource. For example, if you desperately need building materials for your base, it's better to choose one mode, and if you need Heroic Manga, then another. This way, you are guaranteed to receive the reward you need here and now.
So, you can start preparing for a new challenge that will test your courage, speed, and strategic thinking. Introducing the "Chase" mode—dynamic, intense, and full of unexpected twists!

[h3]Monsters Have Found Leaders[/h3]

Something incredible has happened in Singoru. Monsters, which previously acted chaotically, have suddenly united around the strongest. They have chosen leaders—powerful beings whom they now worship as deities. These leaders are not only smarter and stronger than their brethren but also possess a magical connection to ancient totems that grant them immortality.

Now, these monster leaders lead their hordes on hunts, and their target is you. But all is not lost! Even immortality has its weaknesses, and your task is to find and destroy the totems linked to the leader. Only then can you stop the chase and survive.

[h3]How Does the "Chase" Mode Work?[/h3]

From the very beginning of the match, an immortal monster leader will chase you. It cannot be killed in the usual way—it will pursue you until the totems linked to it are destroyed. But be careful: the monster won't just follow you. It will use its abilities to block paths, slow you down, or even call for reinforcements.

The main task is to act quickly. Explore the location, find the totems, and destroy them before the monster catches up to you. But remember: the enemy won't sit idly by! The longer you delay, the more dangerous the situation becomes.

[h3]Unique Enemies for Each Location[/h3]

We have tried to make each match in the "Chase" mode unique. Each location will have its own monster leader with special abilities and tactics.

Today, we want to show the enemy from the "Graveyard" location:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/96c148543443a86c07b94c7ed14f0286a6605548.png[/img]

In future diaries, other enemies will be gradually revealed, each representing a unique threat.

[h2]Finally[/h2]

In the previous issue, we lifted the veil on upcoming changes related to the release of the mobile version of the game. We mentioned an updated interface, cross-platform progression, and many other improvements that will make the game even more convenient and accessible. Today, we would like to show another important step in this direction—the new FoV (Field of View)!

We have tried to make the FoV as comfortable as possible for both mobile devices and PCs/consoles! Moreover, we plan to make it customizable, so each player can adjust it to their preferences and playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/67ee2650e3fad8c017a90e2ce9f64d710e20e748.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more news, as there is still a lot of exciting stuff ahead! In the meantime—share your impressions and expectations in the comments. Forward, Brave Ones!

notes.title: Dev's Diary #19
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We are pleased to present you with a new issue of the "Developers' Diary"!

For everyone who is eager to learn about the changes and innovations awaiting the world of Singoru, we are ready to lift the veil of secrecy.

First, we would like to briefly talk about everything that will soon await the game and you:
[list]
[*] New abilities: summoning creatures;
[*] New Heroes;
[*] Changes to match duration;
[*] Two new modes;
[*] Updates to Town Hall quests;
[*] New locations;
[*] Release on new platforms and crossplay functionality;
[*] Hero rebalancing;
[*] Ability rebalancing;
[*] New skins;
[*] In-game chat.
[/list]
Of course, we can't cover everything in one diary, so we recommend that you don't miss our future issues to learn more about what awaits you next!

In this issue, we will focus on one of the new heroes, changes to match duration, and the release on new platforms!

Well, let's not waste any more time!

[h2]New Hero: Terra[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/1bf0ba3d8b20bf737966e503d9947556b6ff6387.png[/img]

[b]Terra[/b] is a mysterious and talented magical sculptor whose hands can turn ordinary stone into living works of art. Her name, meaning "earth," perfectly reflects her connection to natural materials and earth magic. Terra has the ability not only to create monumental sculptures but also to breathe life into them, imbuing them with magical power. Her main and most powerful ally is the Royal Golem, a massive creature of stone and magic that she can summon in moments of greatest danger. This golem is not only her protector but also the embodiment of her creative genius, a symbol of her mastery over the earth element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8fd690e6455686f9e2bea69359d76a3b86c5c87e.png[/img]

Terra possesses unique abilities that make her even more dangerous and resilient in battle. With a certain chance, when picking up items or gaining experience, she can heal herself, making her durable. Additionally, her earth-element attacks (including golem strikes) can weaken enemies, temporarily reducing their damage. This makes her not only a master of earth magic but also a tactician capable of controlling the flow of battle.

In addition, we would like to show you her appearance, which will be released alongside the hero:[b] Terra - the Cook.[/b] Having reached the pinnacle of mastery in sculpture, Terra decided to challenge herself in a new art—culinary. After all, cooking, like sculpting, requires inspiration, patience, and a fine sense of harmony. While her attempts to create a Gingerbread Golem have not yet been successful, she believes that one day her hands will be able to bring this sweet creation to life. For her, nothing is impossible when it comes to art—be it stone or dough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2a2a60750dc7b6849942fe18c02247c9c489a146.png[/img]

[h2]Changes to Match Duration[/h2]

In anticipation of upcoming updates and the release on new platforms, which we will talk about a bit later, we have decided to reduce the time you spend in matches. But don't worry—this won't affect the size of your rewards!

So, what exactly will change? These changes will affect all maps and difficulty levels in the normal mode:
[list]
[*] Easy difficulty can now be completed in just 5 minutes;
[*] Medium difficulty in 10 minutes;
[*] Hard, Impossible, and Hellish difficulties in 15 minutes!
[/list]
We are confident that these changes will make the gameplay even more dynamic and exciting.

[h2]Cross-Platform[/h2]

In the near future, we plan to release the game on mobile devices (Android/iOS), as well as on the following consoles:
[list]
[*] Nintendo Switch
[*] PlayStation 5
[*] PlayStation 4
[*] Xbox One S
[*] Xbox One X
[*] Xbox One
[/list]
Imagine: you're at a friend's place, and they only have a console. "No problem!" you say, logging into the game. No more "oh, my progress is on another device." You're like a superhero, always ready for battle, whether it's on PC, phone, or console.

And if you suddenly decide to play on the subway (why not?), the mobile version won't let you down either. Progress will be synchronized on your 101XP account, so you can level up even if your PC is sitting sadly at home.

Finally, we would like to show you one of the screenshots of the future mobile interface. Please note that this interface is not the final version and may be subject to change.

Updated Ammunition:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/4e400597e35b537ac80238a8d4fd090738bb1812.jpg[/img]
Details of other changes will be revealed in future diaries!

This concludes our issue. Don't forget to share your impressions and thoughts in the comments—it's very important to us!

[h2]“Holiday Miracle” Gift Marathon![/h2]

Brave Ones!

The New Year is almost here, and for some, it might have already begun. To celebrate this wonderful holiday, we’re launching the “Holiday Miracle” Gift Marathon! It’s filled with delightful rewards that we hope will help you protect Singoru!

[h2]New Weapons[/h2]

Not only do the harsh cold and terrifying monsters come from the far north, but so do tools to fight them. You can acquire these weapons in the Market as random rewards by opening chests with Holiday Bells. What kind of weapons can you get? Let’s take a closer look:

[h3]Shredder[/h3] [b]Legendary Icicle Launcher[/b]
Equipping this grants your hero the [b]Frost Shards[/b] ability.
[list]
[*] +30% to Frost Shards damage and its evolution at uncommon rarity
[*] +15% to all ability damage at rare rarity
[*] +2 levels to Frost Shards ability at the start of a match at epic rarity
[*] +1 evolution level for the Supernova ability at legendary rarity
[*] Fires icy scythes to the left and right of the hero’s movement every 9.5 seconds at mythic rarity
[/list]

[h3]Tear of the Creator[/h3] [b]Legendary Faith Amplifier[/b]
Equipping this grants your hero the [b]Aura of Faith[/b] ability.
[list]
[*] +30% to Aura of Faith damage and its evolution at uncommon rarity
[*] +15% to all ability damage at rare rarity
[*] +2 levels to Aura of Faith ability at the start of a match at epic rarity
[*] +1 evolution level for the Wrath of God ability at legendary rarity
[*] Fires icy scythes to the left and right of the hero’s movement every 9.5 seconds at mythic rarity
[/list]

[h3]Polar Star[/h3] [b]Legendary Shuriken[/b]
Equipping this grants your hero the [b]Steel Fan[/b] ability.
[list]
[*] +30% to Steel Fan damage and its evolution at uncommon rarity
[*] +15% to all ability damage at rare rarity
[*] +2 levels to Steel Fan ability at the start of a match at epic rarity
[*] +1 evolution level for the Blade Dance ability at legendary rarity
[*] Fires icy scythes to the left and right of the hero’s movement every 9.5 seconds at mythic rarity
[/list]

Our moderators made a short video overview of the weapons to make it easier for you to understand how they perform in combat!
[previewyoutube=Nlz7qsPQ7Rg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Balance the Elite Bars![/h2]

We have listened to your feedback! The Elite Bars that have been causing so much trouble promise to behave better. Battles on the fields of Frost Harvest will now be more exciting and fairer. Thank you for your feedback, and good luck with your new adventures!

notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

This year has been challenging yet incredibly exciting. Together, we’ve fought through epic battles, uncovered the secrets of ancient lands, and pushed back the darkness threatening our world. Each of you has been a part of this amazing journey, proving that even the toughest trials can be overcome by those who fearlessly forge ahead.

Your courage and determination have inspired us every single day. Together, we’ve built a new world filled with heroism, magic, and adventure. The journey hasn’t been easy, but looking back, we see how far we’ve come—and it’s all thanks to you.

This Christmas, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude to each of you. May this holiday bring you warmth, comfort, and a touch of magic. And as we step into the new year, even more adventures, challenges, and victories await!

And, of course, we couldn’t celebrate without a gift for you: [b]merrychristmas[/b]

notes.title: The Great Heist Event!
New Year's update!
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

Have you been anxiously waiting for an update? Well, it's finally here, so put on your best armor, grab a weapon, and let's go on an adventure! But first, here’s what's new!

[h2]Hero Soul Fragments Exchange at the Market[/h2]
Some of the most experienced players have accumulated too many Soul Fragments to count, and those are just collecting dust in warehouses... So, what can one do with them? Luckily, an enterprising trader at the Market is now offering to exchange the Fragments of one hero's soul for the other's!
[b]Warning! [/b]
[list]
[*] you can only trade for Soul Fragments belonging to heroes that you already own;
[*] you can only exchange Fragments of the same rarity.
[/list]
[h2]Guarantor in marketplace rewards.[/h2]
Many people have gotten used to the constant randomized marketplace reward events, but what if I told you that now every chest, regardless of its value will now have its own guarantor! Yes brave ones, now you will definitely be able to get your long awaited reward even if you are very unlucky. 
The guarantor and the number of attempts can vary from event to event and chest to chest. To find out what will fall out in the guarantee and the exact number of attempts you need to make to get it - open the hint window, which is on each chest in the upper right corner.

[h2]New Event: Singoru-Style Heist[/h2]
The Goblin Bank prints valuable securities, but its vault has come under attack. The papers were stolen, and it falls to you to track down the thieves: the Mysterious Mr. S already picked up the criminals' trail and requests your help! How could one refuse such a plea? The Goblin Bank owner has paid dearly for his indiscretion, but a secret patron might help the establishment get out of this mess... For a sizable fee, of course! Hit the road, hunt down the crooks at every location, reclaim the stolen goods, and then you can exchange them for some neat rewards at the Market:
[b][h3]New Enemy: Goblin Thief.[/h3][/b] The Goblin Bank owner paid a heavy price for taking pity on a few wayward goblins and offering them a job. The scoundrels had spent months planning their robbery, and now the unfortunate banker lost many valuable securities, while the thieving goblins scattered around the known lands. Look for them around Singoru during the event, and make sure to investigate the new point of interest displayed as the event token. The cowardly Goblin Thief will run for it as soon as you get close, giving you an opportunity to catch him. But be careful and don't lose sight of your target, for you will never find the rascal if you let him run too far!
[h3][b]New Mechanics: Fleeing Enemy.[/b][/h3] We thought about it and decided that monsters chasing down players is getting dull. Let's welcome a new enemy type, such as the Goblin Thief, that comes with unique behavior mechanics! This time, YOU will need to run after them and don't let the sneaky pests get too far away, otherwise they'll escape, leaving you without a valuable reward. Be careful, since this kind of opponent can easily run past the boss arena. Watch that timer!
Event Token: Bill of Exchange. A security paper printed by Goblin Bank employees. You'll be able to cash out any collected Bills at the Market and receive valuable rewards. Get those tokens by defeating Goblin Thieves.

[h3][b]Event Rewards: [/b][/h3]
- Try your luck at the Market and exchange event tokens for a random reward:
[list]
[*] Hero Soul Fragments;
[*] Academy Runes;
[*] Prism Fragments;
[*] Ether Prisms;
[*] Eternity Prisms;
[*] Gold Coins;
[*] Building materials;
[*] Heroic Manga;
[*] Blueprints.
[/list]

[h2]Gift Marathon: Singoru-Style Heist[/h2]
We're kicking off a series of Gift Marathons and decided to coincide the very first one with the new event. This means that you can receive the following rewards completely free of charge: Gold, Ether and Eternity Prisms, Transformation Masks, as well as Event Tokens: Bills of Exchange.
But that's not all! In addition to the standard Gift Marathon, there will also be a premium one, with even more gifts and a cherry on top in the form of the unique Mysterious Mr. S skin — Godfather Mr. S! The mysterious hero declared a vendetta against the Goblin Thieves... As it turns out, the old banker enjoyed his personal protection.

[h2]Effects Transperacy[/h2]
It often happens that, by the end of the match—or even at around the middle point for some of the more audacious heroes—the abundance of different skills active at the same time makes it difficult to see what's actually going on behind all the special effects. The battlefield situation should be crystal clear to our Brave Ones, so that they may come out victorious from any kind of situation. That's why we present a new addition to the game's settings menu, currently running in test mode — the graphical effects transparency slider!
The lower you set it, the less noticeable the visual effects from your characters' skills will be. Feel free to customize this option as you see fit!

[h2]Streamlining the New Player Experience[/h2]

Being brave can be difficult... Some think that it's actually too difficult. That's why we've simplified many of the game's aspects that players can have trouble with when starting out. This includes the following:
Forest location will now be easier to clear, with significantly fewer monsters that can use the Dash ability;
[list]
[*] the Town Hall will now offer increased rewards for the missions in the Forest (up to Hellish difficulty), the Laboratory (up to Impossible difficulty), and the Cemetery (up to Medium difficulty) locations;
[*] there will also be increased rewards for killing bosses in the Forest (up to Hellish difficulty), the Laboratory (up to Impossible difficulty), and the Cemetery (up to Medium difficulty) locations;
[*] more rewards will be included in the location-specific and set offers for Forest, Laboratory, Graveyard, Mycelium, Beginner's Set, Eternity Set, Eternity Warrior Set, Eternity Explorer Set, Explorer Set, and Warrior Set. Up-and-coming Brave Ones will now have an easier time exploring new horizons!
[/list]
[h2]Updated Academy Skills[/h2]
The Academy approved a new curriculum, changing some disciplines, and putting more focus on some of the others. Here's the information we got about the changes from the Dean:
[list]
[*] for Quick Feet, support branch skill: Bonus increased from +5% on Legendary rarity and +7.5% on Mythical to +7.5% on Legendary and +15% on Mythical;
[*] for Magnetism support branch skill: The skill now only works for EXP, while the pick-up radius has been increased from 60%/100%/135% to 75%/125%/200% on Epic/Legendary/Mythical rarities, respectively.
[/list]
[h2]Updated Gear and Hero Special Effects[/h2]
Aside from Academy skills, certain special equipment item effects have also been updated, namely:
[b]Warrior Greaves:[/b]
[list]
[*] +125% to EXP pick-up radius on Epic Rarity, instead of +100% general pick-up radius;
[*] +60% to EXP pick-up radius for every 10 levels gained during a match on Mythic Rarity, instead of +45% general pick-up radius.
[/list]
[b]Barbarian Boots:[/b]
[list]
[*] +125% to EXP pick-up radius on Epic Rarity, instead of +100% general pick-up radius.
[/list]
[b]Ronin Sandals:[/b]
[list]
[*] +125% to EXP pick-up radius on Epic Rarity, instead of +100% general pick-up radius.
[/list]
[b]Truffaldino Hero:[/b]
[list]
[*] +180% to EXP pick-up radius on Epic Rarity, instead of +150% general pick-up radius.
[/list]
[h2]New Portals Opening[/h2]
Can you feel the cold emanating from the portals? The waves of ether bring new heroes to Singoru, and they know exactly how to cool their enemies' ardor... So, let’s welcome the Portals of Winter Cold and Snow Fighting!
Three new, unique characters await you in the Portal of the Winter Cold. What can they do? What surprises do they bring? Let's take a look:

[h3]Aurora.[/h3][b] Legendary Support Hero. [/b]
Aurora grew up amidst the shimmering beauty of the snowy lands and the unearthly dance of the northern lights in the night sky. In her homeland, located at the heart of the frozen tundra, Aurora was revered as the goddess of prosperity and the bringer of good tidings. It's believed that those bearing her blessing are destined for greatness... And here's what she brings to the battlefield:
[h3][b]Legendary Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Northern Lights. Aurora has a chance to summon the Northern Lights upon dealing damage with any skill. Opponents affected by their AoE deal less damage, their health is drained, and they're pushed away from the epicenter of the Northern Lights. Aurora herself, on the contrary, receives a temporary attack power boost;
[*] Frozen Waters. Water skills and their evolutions gain a chance to freeze opponents for 1 sec. Be careful, though, as this skill will only slow down bosses instead;
[*] +100% to Fire and Ice Dragons' and their evolutions' AoE;
[*] +125% knockback force;
[*] -15% Max HP.
[/list]
[h3][b]Mythic Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Wisdom of the North. Aurora has a chance to receive the Wisdom of the North buff upon dealing damage, significantly increasing the amount of EXP she gains for the next 6 sec. The skill then goes into cooldown for 50 sec.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/91e459658ad43a1d2383316f1166e9d1504fd3d1.png[/img]
[h3]Visconti.[/h3] [b]Legendary Damage-dealing Hero.[/b] 
It happens that, when the waves of ether twist and toss the souls of heroes around, sometimes two of them end up in the same body, thrown onto the shores of Singoru. Visconti is one such case, with two principles constantly fighting for control over his mind: an inveterate villain and a pure-hearted, righteous man... Which side will you support? And while you're pondering that eternal question, let's take a look at this hero's skills:
[h3][b]Legendary Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Garment of Light. Upon dealing damage with a Holy skill, Visconti has a chance to gain the Garment of Light buff for 10 sec. In this form, the damage and AoE of his Holy skills will increase, and their cooldown time will be shortened. This ability can activate once every 45 sec.;
[*] Garment of Darkness. Upon dealing damage with a Spirit skill, Visconti has a chance to gain the Garment of Darkness buff for 10 sec., boosting the damage, projectile count, and knockback of his Spirits skills. This ability can activate once every 45 sec.;
[*] Intertwined Fates. The Thread of Life and Thread of Fate skills drop 5 times more often;
[*] +1 revival at the start of the match;
[*] +1 Thread of Life skill level at the start of the match;
[*] +1 Thread of Fate skill level at the start of the match;
[*] +1 Samsara Carpet evolution level;
[*] -25% item pick-up radius;
[*] -60% item pick-up speed.
[/list]
[h3][b]Mythic Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Ideal Garment of Light. higher Garment of Light activation rate, and its cooldown time is reduced to 20 sec.;
[*] Ideal Garment of Darkness. higher Garment of Darkness activation rate, and its cooldown time is reduced to 20 sec.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8e51cec76becc3bc1a98040845438766bc1fcc0d.png[/img]
[h3]Tempesta.[/h3] [b]Epic Defense Heroine. [/b]
Can you feel it? The air's full of electricity, and the clouds grow darker and heavier, about to burst into thunder and lightning. It's the perfect time for Tempesta, the dweller of storms, to make her entrance, ready to bring down the wrath of the heavens onto her enemies' heads!.. And now, let's take a careful look at this character's abilities:
[h3][b]Epic Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Wrath of the Heavens. Has a chance to bring down the Wrath of Heavens onto the battlefield upon dealing damage. This AoE skill deals damage to opponents and stuns them for 3 sec. Be careful, though, as this skill will only slow down bosses instead;
[*] Healing Winds. Every time Tempesta dodges an enemy attack, she heals for 2% of her Max HP;
[*] +6% projectile speed for every 5 levels gained during the match;
[*] +2% evasion rate for every 5 levels gained during the match;
[*] +50% AoE size to Lightning Strike skill and its evolutions;
[*] -3% skill duration for every 5 levels gained during the match.
[/list]
[h3][b]Legendary Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] +2% movement speed for every 5 levels gained during the match.
[/list]
[h3][b]Mythic Rarity:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] -3% skill cooldown time for every 5 levels gained during the match.
[/list]
[u][b]Three new, unique weapons await you in the Portal of Snow Fighting. Let's hear it for:[/b][/u]

[h3]Herald of the Cold.[/h3] [b]Legendary Cold Biter.[/b] 
When equipped, grants the [b]Ice Dragon skill[/b].
[list]
[*] +30% Ice Dragon skill damage on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +5% to all skills' damage on Rare Rarity;
[*] +1 Ice Dragon skill level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity;
[*] +350% Ice Dragon skill knockback on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +1 Kiro skill evolution level on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a91c0999a8f6e7f58a480b5bb4cf4b0a197c1324.png[/img]
[h3]Synergy.[/h3] [b]Legendary Key of Life.[/b] 
When equipped, grants the [b]Thread of Life[/b] skill. 
[list]
[*] +15% Thread of Life and Thread of Destiny skill damage on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +5% to all skills' damage on Rare Rarity;
[*] +1 Damned Souls skill level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity;
[*] 50% chance to double activate the Cursed Souls skill and its evolutions on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +1 Chain Reaction skill evolution level on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/c6a05801408f1c4104c6dca570eeb0ff242fdcb9.png[/img]
[h3]Storm Herald.[/h3] [b]Legendary Lightning Rod.[/b] 
When equipped, grants the [b]Lightning Strike[/b] skill.
[list]

You can already find these at the Tavern and buy them with Gems or Transformation Masks.

Tired of selecting your achievements one by one when decorating your profile? Well, now you won't have to, because we've added the option to select achievements en masse, so that you can adjust their order of appearance in the Achievements Showcase in just a few clicks.

[h2]Festive Spirit Comes to Town[/h2]
Christmas and New Year holidays are upon us! As you know, even in the harshest of times, a grain of joy and happiness can light up even the darkest night. That's why there will also be a festival in our city, and right now you can already see how everything's transformed on the eve of the celebration. Time to kick back and enjoy the festive atmosphere! We hope you will like this change of scenery, Brave Ones!

[h2]Sorting Added to the Tavern and the Academy[/h2]
Finally, the Tavern and the Academy buildings will now save the last sorting settings you've used, meaning that the order in which you prefer to view your heroes will remain even after entering and exiting a match.

We also give you a mysterious code in honor of the update: [b]GREATHEIST[/b]

That's it for now, Brave Ones!Congratulations on reaching the first month of winter, and we hope that you'll like all the innovations this update brings! Stay tuned and share your impressions, since, as always, we're happy to hear your feedback!

notes.title: Dev Diary #18
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We’re excited to present to you a new edition of the "Developer’s Diary"!

For those of you eager to learn about the changes and innovations coming to the world of Singoru, we’re ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this issue, we’ll talk about a new hero and the updates awaiting you!

So, let’s not waste any time!

[h3]New Hero: Tempesta[/h3]

At the edge of the world, where the sky meets the earth and storms never cease, resides Tempesta—the goddess of wind and lightning. Her home is a boundless palace among the clouds, from where she watches over the mortal realm, commanding the elements. In her eyes, a hurricane rages, and her voice resonates like thunder.

In battle, the wind cloaks Tempesta like a veil, granting her an incredible ability to evade attacks, increasing her dodge rate every five levels. If she successfully dodges, she immediately restores a portion of her health. Even the heavens themselves stand ready to aid her, striking her enemies with lightning! But that’s just a glimpse of her abilities—after all, every woman should have her mysteries, right?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/146a4ef35bc026cfa2ec4786357d1cb71ac0bde0.png[/img]
Tempesta is a reminder that nature is powerful yet fair. She demands respect but is always willing to forgive and grant new life to those seeking harmony.

[h3]Reward Adjustments[/h3]

Have you already conquered the hardcore Bran, but the daily rewards are still the same as when you first arrived in Singoru? We’ve decided to change that!

Now, as you progress through locations and unlock new difficulties, the rewards will scale accordingly!

Finally, it’s time to thrive!

[h3]Event Guarantees[/h3]

Have you spent countless hours playing to get that coveted event reward, but it just won’t drop? Feeling frustrated? Well, not anymore!
Soon, all new events will feature a guaranteed drop system for event-related chests! This means that if luck abandons you, you can rely on the guarantee to ensure you get what you’ve been striving for!

That’s it for this edition of the Developer’s Diary. Don’t forget to share your impressions and thoughts in the comments—it means the world to us!

notes.title: Dev Diary #17
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We’re excited to present a new edition of the Developer’s Diary!

For everyone eager to know about the changes and innovations coming to the world of Singoru, we’re ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this issue, we’ll talk about a new hero, new functionality, and the main villain of the upcoming event!

So, let’s not waste any time!

[h2]New Hero: Visconti.[/h2]

The Aether is a realm where the souls of heroes await their turn. But even there, extraordinary events can occur—things that seem impossible in the real world. For instance, the merging of opposites, which is embodied in Visconti.

Visconti is a unique mage whose potential is hard to gauge, as he is the fusion of two souls and two beginnings. His light side embodies hope and aid for those in need, while his dark side symbolizes retribution for anyone who crosses the line and brings evil to Singoru.

Visconti specializes in wielding two types of energy, allowing him to assume both light and dark forms in battle. His duality protects him, triggering explosive bursts of both energies when he’s in danger. His ability to manipulate the threads of life and fate enables him to not only attract them to his side but also change his destiny in moments of peril, even resurrecting himself after death.

This is the third winner of the Hero Creation Contest, following Aurora and Kalizka!

[h2]Authorization.[/h2]

What’s the point of authorization if we’re playing through Steam? you might ask. After all, Steam already has account linking! And we’d respond with one word: cross-platform!

Yes, a new era is coming to the game, allowing you to play across different platforms. To make this possible, authorization via 101XP is required. You’ll be able to quickly authorize through the settings menu with just a couple of clicks.

While cross-platform functionality won’t be part of the next update, it’s coming to your doorstep very soon.

[h2]An Enemy Approaches!
[/h2]
Remember one of our recent Developer’s Diaries, where we mentioned new events? Well, we’re revealing a bit more! What awaits you there? What new mechanics will be introduced? That, we won’t tell—yet.

However, we can show you the new enemy so you can recognize them on sight!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/464657545f9dad47f27beda380f282e29fcb68a1.png[/img]
But don’t underestimate them based on appearances; they’re not as simple as they seem. They’ve got more than a few tricks up their sleeve—or, in this case, their bag!

Singoru is in for more upheavals, both good and bad. But we’re confident you’ll save this world from anything bad, just as you always have!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ca6ed5eecf6cb219a48414d868e1190854b9e35e.png[/img]
That concludes this edition of the Developer’s Diary. Don’t forget to share your thoughts and impressions in the comments—they mean a lot to us!

Aurora, who was born in the icy lands of the North, grew up amidst mesmerizing snow-covered landscapes and the unearthly dance of the Northern Lights in the night sky. notes.title: Dev Diary #15
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We are pleased to present you a new issue of the Developer Diary!

For all those who are hungry for knowledge about what changes and innovations await the world of Singora we are ready to lift the veil of mystery. In this issue we will tell you about the new hero, changes in the Academy and events that await you!

Well, let's not waste any time, shall we?

[h3]New hero: Kalizk![/h3]

He once loved to bring joy by giving gifts, but one day he lost everything and embarked on the dark path of necromancy. Years later, he is ready to give gifts again, but now they are meant for his enemies and they probably won't like them....
Kalizk is able to summon his handmaidens for an unqualified victory on the battlefield. Although he is a defensive hero, this does not make him weak, for his attacks are capable of tearing the soul of his enemies, allowing him to regenerate his health during battle. And death is just a new beginning for him, because what's a necromancer without resurrection? Here and Kalizk is able to resurrect with full health to show everyone that jokes should be joked about elsewhere.

I would like to note that the hero is still in the early stages, and therefore some aspects in appearance or abilities may change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/618b9a373ca973c265b482179eb24dbfe3db721e.png[/img]

[h3]Black Friday![/h3]
Of course, what's November without a Friday as black as the soul of the person who wrote this text? Tell me, brave people, are you already preparing for it? Are you looking forward to it? We are. For this day we prepare you not only nice discounts on different assortment, but also a new event with unique mechanics of the opponent in the match!
Of course, we would like to share all the details at once, but the intrigue lover, who compiled this text, decided to say only a couple of phrases to make everything so mysterious.

[h3]Changes at the Academy![/h3]
Another reshuffle in the Academy. The leaders have decided to listen to the students, and that's why everyone gets credit without exams!
And seriously, by popular demand, in the near future the Academy will have the functionality of resetting reinforcements for heroes. This will allow you to reset all the skills of the hero in the chosen branch and return 100% of the resources spent (the dean of the Academy was against it, he wanted to take a percentage, but we agreed with him).

So pretty soon you will be able to throw off the shackles of choice and boldly experiment!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8591e76514c2f1bd851ef51cdec1e3797704a8cb.png[/img]
This is the end of our issue, don't forget to share your impressions and thoughts in the comments - it's very important for us!

notes.title: Halloween update!
notes.content:
Brave Ones!
 
October is coming to an end, and we all know what that means... Halloween is coming to Singoru, no one can ignore this holiday! Put on your spookiest costumes, arm yourself with the most frightening smile, and go forth to adventures!
 
[h2]New Event – Halloween[/h2]

The days are growing shorter, while the nights are getting longer and colder. The peasants, finishing this year's final harvest, have begun to find strange sweets in the fields. How did they get there, and who have scattered them around? The answer is simple — a new evil has befallen Singoru, and only the bravest will be able to face it and obtain worthy trophies!
[b]New Boss – Sinister Scarecrow.[/b] Animated by childhood fears, this garden scarecrow now fashions itself a big bad villain... Funny, huh? Well, don't let your guard done just yet, since this opponent has a set of dangerous abilities that can make even the most seasoned adventurers sweat! Throughout the event, it will appear at the 11th minute on the map of your choosing — simply look for the new icon in the form of the Cursed Candy event token.
[b]Event Token – Cursed Candy.[/b] This ominous candy seems to have a mind of its own... You are unlikely to be tempted to eat it, but rumor has it that there are real connoisseurs for this kind of sweets on the market. Collect Cursed Candies by defeating the Sinister Scarecrow.
[b]Event Rewards: [/b]
Try your luck and exchange event tokens for a random reward at the Market:
[list]
[*] New unique Scarecrow Set;
[*] Academy Runes;
[*] Prism Fragments;
[*] Prisms of the Ether;
[*] Prisms of Eternity;
[*] Gold Coins;
[*] Building materials;
[*] Heroic Manga;
[*] Blueprints.
[/list]
You can exchange event tokens for new character skins at the Tavern. Read on for more details.
 
[h2]New Armor Set [/h2]
By exchanging event tokens for prizes at the Market, you have a rare chance to get the unique Scarecrow Set. As is tradition, your efforts will be well-rewarded, because this set's stats are significantly higher, compared to all others that can be obtained outside of events. Want to know more about its properties?

[h3]Scarecrow Rags[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Quick Metabolism skill will activate more frequently;
[*] +15% damage dealt with all skills on Rare Rarity;
[*] The Quick Metabolism skill will activate even more frequently while your hero is standing in place on Epic Rarity;
[*] +13% evasion rate on Legendary Rarity;
[*] -13% incoming damage on Mythic Rarity;
[/list]
[h3]Scarecrow Head[/h3]
[list]
[*] +15% revival healing bonus on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +15% damage dealt with all skills on Rare Rarity;
[*] +5 sec. to post-revival invulnerability duration on Epic Rarity;
[*] +1 revive on Legendary Rarity
[*] +10% to skill AoE while your hero is standing in place on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
[h3]Scarecrow Boots[/h3]
[list]
[*] +100% item pick-up speed on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +15% damage dealt with all skills on Rare Rarity;
[*] +5% movement speed on Epic Rarity;
[*] 15% chance to double-activate skills on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +20% projectile speed while your hero is standing in place on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
[h3]Scarecrow Gloves[/h3]
[list]
[*] 10% fire rate on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +15% max HP on Rare Rarity;
[*] +100% knockback while your hero is standing in place on Epic Rarity;
[*] 15% chance to deal double damage on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +20% skill duration while your hero is standing in place on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
[h3]Scarecrow Vine[/h3]
[list]
[*] Applies 2.5% slowdown to enemies on skill hit;
[*] +15% max HP on Rare Rarity;
[*] +4 skill skips during the match on Epic Rarity;
[*] +4 skill bans during the match on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +4 skill rerolls during the match on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
 
The Set Bonus is an active skill: While your hero is wearing the full Scarecrow Set, pumpkins will explode and crows fly across the entire battlefield once every 30 seconds, pushing all on-screen enemies away from the explosion epicenter and causing 500% attack damage.
 
[h2]New Portals are Opening[/h2]
The Ether Ocean has turned crimson red and revealed new heroes ready to fight the monster hordes. Want to know more about them? Then behold — the Portals of the Otherworld and Cursed Items!
Three new, unique heroes await you in the Portal of the Other World. Let's give three cheers for...
[h3]Headless Thomas.[/h3] [b]Legendary Hero[/b]. 
It's always best to keep your head about you, right? Well, poor Thomas failed to follow this golden rule... Too bad for his enemies, though, since this hero, clad in sturdy armor and wielding his faithful twin blades, is going to get them even from beyond the grave! Let's take a look at his skills:
[b]Legendary Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] Gravely Cold Strike. Hitting an enemy with the Whirlwind of Blades or the Bloody Harvest skill may stun them for 2 seconds. Be careful, as this skill won't stun bosses, but will slow them down instead;
[*] Aura of Decomposition. After dealing damage for the first time in battle, Thomas summons clouds of flies to feast on his enemies' remains. From that moment onwards and until the end of the match, the hero will be surrounded by an Aura of Decomposition, causing damage to all nearby opponents and reducing their attack power;
[*] Curse of the Headless. When dealing damage, Thomas has a chance to briefly curse everyone in an area around himself. Affected enemies will take damage, and their attack speed will be reduced;
[*] Cover of the Damned. Upon receiving damage, Thomas has a chance to become invulnerable for a short period of time. This skill can activate once every 30 seconds;
[*] +30% max HP;
[*] -10% movement speed.
[/list]
[b]Mythic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] -30% to Whirlwind of Blades and its evolutions' cooldown time.
[*] +1 level of Unprecedented Health at the start of the match. 
[/list]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/317d8ba975b76a40f410b6c350eea59789d473ef.png[/img]
[h3]Mother Bridget.[/h3] [b]Legendary Heroine.[/b]
Who will comfort those who are beyond the realm of the living? Who will sing them a lullaby and calm the souls trembling with horror and loneliness? The dead are like lost children to Mother Bridget, and as she's always ready to protect them, so do they, in turn, come to her aid. What can this heroine do on the battlefield?
[b]Legendary Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] Grief of the Ancestors. Upon dealing damage to an enemy, Mother Bridget has a chance to summon souls of the dead that will scatter around, inflicting wounds and leaving a poisonous cloud behind that will slowly drain the life of any foe in its range;
[*] Wrath of the Ancestors. When taking damage, Mother Bridget has a chance to appeal to her ancestors. This will summon ghostly skulls flying in all directions from the heroine, dealing damage and repelling nearby enemies;
[*] Knowledge of the Ancestors. Mother Bridget is guaranteed to receive a skill book for defeating mini-bosses;
[*] Proper Nutrition. Mother Bridget appreciates delicious food and drinks. Healing from all pick-up items is boosted 20%;
[*] Fragile Chests. Bombs picked up by Mother Bridget will destroy all revealed chests on the map. This skill doesn't apply to points of interest and event chests;
[*] Gifts for Mother. Magnets picked up by Mother Bridget attract all items on the map and not just experience. This skill doesn't apply to points of interest.
[/list]
[b]Mythic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] +4 skill skips during the match;
[*] +4 skill bans during the match;
[*] +4 skill rerolls during the match.
[/list]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/32e2489fbe00cb0889a2e30ad84559cfe90e26aa.png[/img]
[h3]Bloody Mary.[/h3] [b]Epic Heroine.[/b]
Don't be afraid of mirrors. No one is going to steal your soul or sneak in through them to turn your house into a horror movie set. There's no need to be afraid of mirrors anyway, because their mistress has joined the forces of good... Sound intriguing? Well, of course — Bloody Mary arrives straight from your nightmares and brings painful death to your enemies! Let's take a closer look at what this heroine is capable of on the battlefield:
[b]Epic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] Wave of Blood. Fires a large blood sphere in the direction of the cursor (or your gamepad's right stick) once every 10 seconds. The projectile explodes upon colliding with an enemy, causing damage and leaving behind a blood puddle. Enemies caught in the puddle will take damage, and their movement speed will decrease;
[*] Bloodsplosion. Upon successfully dodging an enemy attack, Bloody Mary has a chance to explode, causing damage to everyone on the battlefield;
[*] Deadly Speed. When taking damage, Bloody Mary only grows more excited for the battle at hand. The lower her health is, the higher the projectile speed of all her active skills;
[*] +15% evasion rate;
[*] +60% projectile speed for Spirit skills;
[*] Picky Eater. Mary's difficult to please, especially when it comes to food. Healing from all pick-up items is reduced by 50%;
[*] Poor Metabolism. The Quick Metabolism skill activates less often. The noble pallor of the skin is a product of hard work.
[/list]
[b]Legendary Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dark Healing. Bloody Mary knows how to keep her beauty and youth with a little help from the dark arts. Every time she deals damage with Unholy Barrier and its evolutions, she has a chance to restore a portion of her health..
[/list]
[b]Mythic Rarity:[/b]
[list]
[*] Curved Mirrors. Mary knows how to trick her enemies using mirrors. The effectiveness of the Nimble passive skill is boosted 25%. For example, that skill usually grants +33% evasion rate at level 5, but with Curved Mirrors, this bonus is boosted to +41%. The best way to stay alive is to never take damage at all! 
[*] +1 Nimble skill level at the start of the match.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/83ab8d472cb487aca377656a3c03e9173ffd8025.png[/img] 
[b]Three new, unique weapons await you in the Portal of Cursed Items, so meet the...[/b]

[h3]Twins of Eternity. Legendary Twin Blades.[/h3] [b]Grants the Whirlwind of Blades skill when equipped.[/b]
[list]
[*] +30% Whirlwind of Blades damage on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +5% damage dealt with all skills on Rare Rarity;
[*] +1 Whirlwind of Blades level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity;
[*] +1 Whirlwind of Blades projectile on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +1 Bloody Harvest skill evolution level on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/7b6a5adbe696a8e5a9ee88e2c1c2649017a15305.png[/img]
[h3]Ancestral Skull. Legendary Soul Shooter.[/h3] [b]Grants the Cursed Souls skill when equipped. [/b]
[list]
[*] +30% Cursed Souls damage on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +5% damage dealt with all skills on Rare Rarity;
[*] +1 Cursed Souls level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity;
[*] 50% chance to double-activate the Cursed Souls skill and its evolutions on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +1 Chain Reaction skill evolution level on Mythic Rarity.
[/list]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/fdbc2aedd1c66db5b5e58bff73a9374a88d9211c.png[/img]
[h3]Oblivion Shard. Legendary Cursed Sickle.[/h3] [b]Grants the Unholy Barrier skill when equipped.[/b]
[list]
[*] +30% Unholy Barrier damage on Uncommon Rarity;
[*] +5% damage dealt with all skills on Rare Rarity;
[*] +1 Unholy Barrier level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity;
[*] +12% Unholy Barrier damage for every 10 levels gained during the match on Legendary Rarity;
[*] +1 You Shall Not Pass! skill evolution level on Mythic Rarity;
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/e8b0f394a04cfd4c3eb8c2e0f043dfc0da87999b.png[/img]
[h2]Hero Skins[/h2]
Halloween is coming to town, and everyone knows that it's customary to dress up in scary costumes for this holiday. That's why we thought it appropriate to grant you the option to change your heroes' looks! A new tab has been added to the Hero menu at the Tavern: "Appearance." There, you will be able to see all the skins available for the selected hero, as well as any bonuses they provide.
It was decided to divide skins into the Event and Common categories.
[list]
[*] Event Skins. Skins that you can purchase with Gems or event tokens go here. Once an event ends, related skins can still be bought with Gems, plus the new currency — Masks of Transformation, which can be collected from bosses once the Halloween event ends.
[*] Common Skins. These will always be available for Gems and Masks of Transformation.
[/list]
To start things off, we've prepared a few Event Skins for you to dress up your favorite hero for the current holiday.
Applying skins will affect how your character looks in matches, as well as in all of the menus. Oh, and don't forget about the pleasant stat bonus that every skin provides!
Okay, that covers the skins, but what about Masks of Transformation? What are those, and where can you find them? Simple: the masks are a new resource that you can get for killing bosses after the Halloween event ends. The higher the difficulty level, the more Masks of Transformation you will get! Oh, and the Masks don't affect any other rewards received from bosses, but only complement them, so don't worry about them replacing any of the previously existing boss trophies.
We'll try to add new skins for your favorite heroes as often as possible, so you can look forward to more of them in the coming updates!
 
[h2]Gameplay Enhancement — Lab[/h2]
We continue to improve your gaming experience in certain locations. Today it's the Lab's turn! Local enemies will now gain difficulty level-dependent special properties.
How will this affect your experience? Simple:
[list]
[*] The Lab will be easier to clear on lower difficulties.
[*] As the difficulty grows, enemies will begin to sport new mechanics and properties, contributing to a more engaging and tactical match.
[/list]
We hope that these changes, will make your runs on the Lab location more varied and thrilling!
 
[h2]Player Profile [/h2]
As many new online features are looming on the horizon (such as in-game chats, clans, and competitions), we're now adding player profiles!
Let's take a look at why do you need a profile, and what can you do with it!
Player profile reflects their in-game progress and overall strength. In the future, you will be able to customize your profile's appearance and show off important achievements for other players to see. It also automatically displays your time spent in-game, the server and, of course, level.
[b]Anticipating the questions about how you can raise your profile level, here is the answer: [/b]
[list]
[*] by upgrading your buildings; 
[*] by leveling up heroes at the Tavern;
[*] by improving hero skills at the Academy.
[/list]
There will be other ways to level up your profile in the future, so stay tuned!

[b]Profile Appearance.[/b]
[list]
[*] Think of your profile as a personal hall of fame that showcases your favorite heroes and rare achievements, which you're especially proud of!
[*] Choose an avatar from among the portraits of your unlocked heroes and their skins. Your avatar can then be decorated with one of the many frames that will become available as you progress through the game, gain achievements, etc.
[*] Select your country's flag from the list, or just the flag of a place you really like. You can even opt to fly the colors of Singoru... The choice is entirely yours!
[/list]
In the near future and as the game develops, we plan to add new features to the profile menu, so feel free to send us your ideas and suggestions!
 
[h2]Hero Sounds[/h2]
We've begun to bestow our heroes with the gift of speech that reflects their archetypes. Funny, serious, sullen, apathetic… Each hero will now delight you with their exclamations when interacting both in the city and on the battlefield!
In the future, we will expand the range of available archetypes, so who knows... If you like the idea, then every character might even get their own unique voice lines! Everything's in your hands!
 
[h2]Hero Rebalancing[/h2]
As you may have noticed, different heroes had varying attack and health growth rates. As they levelled up, the characters' stats could grow slowly at first, but then suddenly accelerate. This led to a situation where, at low levels, the stats of one hero would be lower than those of another, but then they would suddenly switch places at higher levels.
This could potentially mislead players, so we decided to adjust the stat growth rates going forward. Now, if you see that one hero initially has higher attack than another, then you can be sure things will remain that way at higher levels, too.
How will this change affect gameplay? At lower levels (up to level 10), you may notice lower stat growth for certain heroes than they used to have until now. That said, this earlier stage of battle usually doesn't take long to complete and, at higher levels, the stat growth will become a lot more noticeable.
It's important to note that max level stats remain unchanged!
We hope that this innovation will help you better navigate character progression and give you more opportunities for strategic planning!
Additionally, as part of this rebalancing act, the stats and skills of the [b]Slippery Dave hero[/b] were slightly altered:
[list]
[*] Slippery Dave's Mythic specialization that reduces the regeneration period from the Quick Metabolism passive skill for each equipped Water Skill was adjusted from -1 sec. to -0.75 sec.
[*] His attack and HP reserve has also been increased. 
[/list]
[h2]Sorting Heroes by Class[/h2]
You can now sort your heroes by their class at the Tavern and the Academy for faster and more convenient character management!

[h2]Increased Combo Skill Drop Rates[/h2]
Does it sometimes happen that all the rerolls and skips have been spent, but the necessary skill for that sweet, sweet evolution just didn't show up? What's bad luck, and how should you deal with it? Don't worry — we've got you covered!
We've increased the chance of evolution element skills showing up if you already have its partner. For example, if you possess the Powerful Swing skill, your chance to get the Destructive Strike 1 will be much higher. Please note that this change will only affect 1st-level skills that you don't yet have!
We hope that this will make your play sessions even more enjoyable and comfortable.
 
[h2]Monsters will Use Active Skills Better[/h2]
We've fed our monsters some brain-stimulating vitamins, so they shall now behave more intelligently on the battlefield. The enemies will now use their active skills more adequately and when appropriate. If, for example, the boss is following you around and for whatever reason can't apply a skill on you, then after a few seconds they will re-think their behavior and use another ability instead.
This will make your fights more dynamic and interesting, adding even more challenge and adrenaline to every match!
 
[h2]Some Plans for the Near Future[/h2]
We have so many plans… Firstly, we're going to resume our developer diaries so that you can gradually receive all the necessary information about upcoming updates. Attentive readers may have already noticed that we're preparing an in-game chat that will be available from the City, as well as a system of in-game clans, ratings, and other leaderboards for you to place in and compete for valuable prizes!

A new location is already being actively developed, as well as — and this is largely thanks to our loyal players — a new skill and a number of novel in-game mechanics. The details are currently hidden under a veil of secrecy, but that's bound to change in the fullness of time!
Finally, another major announcement: we're preparing to launch on new platforms, so get ready to play The Braves on consoles and mobile devices!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2ba1c05deadce4858cbd98c54f59a8afe0599298.png[/img]
We have also prepared a Mysterious code for you in honor of the update: [u][b]spookyhalloween[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/5101f48e75b9fb0a5d5532d682130083878a07e4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2ba1c05deadce4858cbd98c54f59a8afe0599298.png[/img]
That's all for now, Brave Ones. The "creepy" month of October is drawing to a close, but the celebration of All Saints' Eve is in full swing! Stay tuned and share your impressions of the game in its present state — we're always happy to read your feedback, as it helps us make our title even better!

notes.title: Hero Creation Contest
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

It's time to show off your creative side! If you are skilled with a brush or are a master of the written word, then this contest is for you. The heroes of Singoru diligently keep hordes of monsters at bay, but strength alone isn't always enough—an outstretched hand in the form of your art will do wonders for the troops' morale!

[u][b]And so, we're announcing an artistic contest!
[/b][/u]
Your task will be to create the image of a new hero you'd like to see in-game.

Here are some [b]guidelines[/b] to aim your creative efforts in the right direction:
[list]
[*] The hero's design should adhere to a Christmas- or New Year-like festive theme. Any imagery related to this topic will do, be it something from legends, myths, TV shows, or mass media... Even just some bells, a warm coat, or a glowing red nose. Let your imagination run wild!
[*] A written story about the proposed hero's adventures will be rewarded with an extra prize;
[*] A description of the hero's skills, as well as a mention of which class they belong to (Attack, Defense, or Support), will likewise not go unnoticed and yield a pleasant surprise to the author;
[*] Finally, if your character prefers to use a certain type of weapon, and you will elaborate on that—you may receive an additional gift!
[/list]
And here are the [b]contest’s terms and conditions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Your entry must be created from scratch, and the artwork may not infringe on any existing copyrights;
[*] You can draw your character's concept art both on paper and digitally;
[*] You may use AI to generate your submission;
[*] By participating in this competition, you grant us permission to implement your character idea(s) in our game;
[*] Manually-made and AI-generated entries will be evaluated and awarded separately;
[*] All entries must be uploaded to the “Artwork” section of the game’s community hub: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2479830/images/
[/list]
And now let's move on to the best part, i.e. the rewards. The winners will not only receive [b]general participation prizes[/b], but also be able to [u][b]pick up the hero[/b][/u] they invented immediately after the Portal opens, making said character available to the public. This occasion will most likely be linked to a certain New Year's miracle.

notes.title: The academy's grand opening!
notes.content:
Brave ones!

Meet the new after-hours update that we're sure will delight everyone! What's in store for you, you ask? Read on and find out! 

[h2]New building — The Academy[/h2]
For a long time this building stood abandoned, but thanks to the efforts of the Braves, the Academy found new teachers. Now anyone can rebuild the Academy and train their heroes in it. 
Training is divided into three branches: Attack, Defense and Support. Any hero can learn skills in all three branches, but each of them has their own preferences in training. So attacking heroes will learn the strongest skills of the attack branch, and defense heroes will learn the strongest skills of the defense branch. 
But the personal preferences of the heroes also play a role. Two attacking heroes can have different number of levels in the same skills, and all because one hero prefers the speed of projectiles, and the other strength of blows.  
To train heroes in the Academy, you will need Runes and gold coins. Each branch of development needs its own runes. The level of the Academy determines how many skills you can learn each individual hero, as well as the maximum rarity of these skills. 
Where can you find runes? It's very simple:
[list]
[*] they will now be sold like any other resource in the marketplace
[*] Look for them at points of interest in matches
[*] defeat bosses in matches and get them as a reward.
[*] rune sets in a jar - fast and convenient!
[/list]

[h2]Weapons Portal Improvements[/h2]
We really want every prism spent by the Braves to bring joy. Therefore, we are happy to announce that from now on, you will not encounter items from the Popadanz set in all weapon portals. Also, the minimum rarity of items in weapon portals has been changed to Rare. Now no items of ordinary and unusual rarity! But that's not all, when you summon x10 you will be guaranteed to get an epic item!

[h2]Reinforcement of old heroes[/h2]
We continue a good tradition of revising the skills of old heroes to make the game with them more enjoyable for all Braves. This time, three heroes have new powers, and the most interesting thing is that all three of them are elves. Coincidence? Who knows? Meet the renewed [b]Midnight Witch, Slippery Ice, and Dancing Flame.[/b]
[h3]Dancing Flame. Epic rarity:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Draconid Form:[list]
[*] Increased chance to turn into a draconid when dealing damage to an enemy.
[*] Fire Sphere. In addition to the familiar puddles of magma, Dancing Flame can now unleash a Fire Sphere that deals massive fire damage to anyone in its path and then explodes. The direction of the sphere is customizable, and will point wherever the mouse cursor (or right stick, in the case of the joystick) is pointing during activation.
[*] +75% to the size of Plamedrag and its evolution 
[/list][/list]
[h3]Slippery Ice. Epic Rarity:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Draconid Form:[list]
[*] Increased chance to turn into a draconid when taking damage.
[*] Ice Sphere. In addition to the familiar puddles of ice, Slippery Ice can now unleash an Ice Sphere that deals massive water damage to anyone in its path and then explodes. The direction of the sphere is customizable, and will point wherever the mouse cursor (or right stick, in the case of the joystick) is pointing during activation.
[*] +75% to the size and evolution of the Chladodryg. 
[/list][/list]
[h3]Midnight Witch. Epic Rarity:[/h3]
[list]
[*] +2 Cursed Sickles projectiles (was +1)
[*] +50% to the size of Cursed Sickles (was +35%).
[*] Mushroom Glade:[list]
[*] Increased the chance of Mushroom Glade appearing when dealing damage to an enemy.
[*] Increased the damage of Mushroom Glade.
[*] Decreased Mushroom Glade's rollback time.
[/list][/list]

We're also giving you a mystic code in honor of the update: [b]RUNICSKILLS[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/45d0c6dc1359ad0a2608a557150194ebafb52d41.png[/img]

That's all for now, Braves. The next update is coming soon and it will bring you new heroes, new weapons and a new event, timed to coincide with the opening of the Academy!

notes.content:
Brave ones!

We are pleased to present you a new issue of the Developer Diary!

You're probably wondering what's in store for you in the near future? We are here to lift the veil of mystery.
In this issue we will tell you about the secrets of the Academy, where your heroes will soon go. We will also show you the new armor and tell you a little about the new point of interest.


[h3]New build and feature - Academy;[/h3]

Rejoice! Soon you will be able to rebuild the Academy, where every hero will be able to get an enhancement. With this enhancement, heroes will be able to defend Singora even better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/2594e24616d9137eae5925d218205180b7311f3d.png[/img]

A new feature will allow you to improve various aspects of any hero in three areas: attack, defense, and general stats.

Runes that can be used to improve will be obtained during a match for killing bosses and from points of interest. There are a total of three types of runes, corresponding to the three directions of pumping.Some passive skills may require several types of runes, and others may not be available to certain heroes,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/36ce7c366e3aa77a088ad0df0ca7c0f19a0ba723.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Armor Set:[/h3]

 A new set of armor will soon be available in the game. We will not reveal the way to get it, but we can assure you that with perseverance every brave player will be able to get it.

In the meantime, we invite you to think about what this new armor set might be called?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a4bfd9d4f9b2593e000f5359b2cdef92a7837be2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/d587a1ceadebd8e8c3fbe19ab01cadd1fd7e2599.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/948a20b55d504b2a2dcacd10824b49f4b4f29192.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/f24f0a363e19dfb7ceac1e12e753b168f1861ba5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/894ce05ef00cda7edb63af591b0b1fe1ed61c1c5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/1fb2e2ee8e996bbe9e9d2262446201f5646c1040.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/e34b4c8b00003ae38e96752af2b4a347f92ef1aa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/9805ed7868b3bc69f7640e8488cab2b28233dfe9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ed5f394e55e11ec4667c57424b2fa755c49d44d1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/08355e2e768c178fd04adca4090884370c7a8ea5.png[/img][/url]

[h3]New, optional, boss:[/h3]

There will be a new optional boss in the game, which will appear on the map as a point of interest. Bosses will not appear all the time, but only at certain moments when Venus is in conjunction with Jupiter, and all the stars will point to the location of the boss.

By defeating the boss, you will not only demonstrate your strength and skill, but also get valuable rewards.

Our issue is coming to an end, don't forget to share your impressions and thoughts in the comments - it's very important for us!

notes.title: Sands Of Time update
notes.content:
Brave Ones!

We are back to tell you all about the recent additions to the game! What awaits you in the current update?

[h2]New Portals Opening[/h2]

Summer is coming to an end, but the ether currents are still filled with red-hot wind and burning sand... Behold [u][b]the Portals of the Scorching Sun and Desert Treasures![/b][/u]

Three new, unique heroes await you in the Portal of the Scorching Sun. It is time you finally meet them:

[h3]Bastet [/h3]

Legendary Heroine. Filled with ancient wisdom and piety, Bastet is ready to stand up for the innocent souls of Singor and locate the source of evil that has poisoned these lands. What does this cute-looking feline hold in her arsenal?

[list][*][b]Legendary rarity[/b][list]

[*] The Wisdom of the Desert. Bastet possesses vast knowledge of long-forgotten ancient peoples, allowing her to learn an extra passive skill.
[*] Perfect Calculations. Bastet knows how to make the most of every shot. When the number of projectiles launched with any skill reaches 3, all subsequent projectiles will deal 30% more damage upon every activation. For example, if Bastet launches 5 fireballs, the first 2 will deal normal damage with each activation, while fireballs 3, 4, and 5 will deal additional damage.
[*] +35% damage dealt with the Thread of Life skill and its evolution
[*] -7% damage dealt with other skills
[*] -15% skill cooldown
[*] +1 Samsara Carpet skill evolution level [/list][/list]

[list][*] [b]Mythical rarity[/b][/list][list][list]

[*] The Fury of the Desert. The desert can be a treacherous place, but Bastet is not: she is used to shining her light upon the poor and taking up arms to protect the defenseless… And yet, woe be to those who provoke her wrath. Bastet's Mythical Rarity variation has a chance to learn an extra active skill.
[*] +2 Thread of Life skill levels at the start of the match
[/list][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/f6f3ee891e60f00210fa3dff5a6b8faf80de9e1b.png[/img]

[h3]Sobek[/h3]

Legendary Hero. You always know when Sobek is nearby due to his dark aura of pain and misery. After fighting and devouring darkness for centuries, Sobek's heart had eventually hardened, and the sinister arts he swore to ward off began to take hold of him. What can this Legendary Hero do?

[list][*] [b]Legendary rarity[/b][/list][list][list]

[*] Sobek's Rage. Upon receiving damage for the first time in a fight, Sobek falls into a rage, barely able to contain the malevolent power within. A destructive aura spreads, causing damage to anyone who would dare approach him.
[*] Thorns of Darkness. After receiving damage, Sobek has a chance to summon Thorns of Darkness in a large radius around him. These will deal damage to the hero's enemies, while also slowing down their movement speed and attack rate. This skill can activate once every 15 seconds.
[*] +35% damage dealt with the Thread of Fate skill and its evolution
[*] -7% damage to other skills
[*] -50% cooldown time for the Thread of Fate skill, but note that cooldown time will increase by 5% for every 2 levels, up to level 10, at which point the cooldown bonus will be reduced to just -25%.
[*] 50% larger Thread of Fate skill's area of effect
[*] +1 Avatar of Darkness level at the start of the match
[*] +1 Samsara Carpet skill evolution level

[/list][/list][list][*] [b]Mythical rarity[/b][/list][list]
[list][*] +2 Thread of Fate skill levels at the start of the match
[*] The Blessing of Light and Darkness. X5 bonus towards the success rate of activating the Thread of Fate and Thread of Life skills whenever you gain a level during the current match.
[/list][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/34c598145eb79a9858ba9991c0fbad3c74323075.png[/img]

[h3]Kashta[/h3] 

Epic Hero. Do you know the saying "one-man army"? Whoever coined it has probably met Kashta. Legends have it that this warrior crossed the desert and seized the royal throne all by himself. Sounds promising, does it not? Let us see what this hero can do!

[list][*] [b]Epic rarity[/b][/list][list][list][*] The Falcon of the Desert. Kashta knows when it is better to fight the enemy head on or outflank them. Upon taking damage, he gains a 75% speed boost that is then decreased by 15% every second. This skill can activate once every 15 seconds.
[*] The Arena of Glory. When selecting any item other than experience, Kashta summons the Arena of Glory to the battlefield. As long as opponents remain within its boundaries, their attack power will be reduced, and they will suffer continuous damage. This skill can activate once every 20 seconds.
[*] +25% projectile movement speed
[*] +35% fire rate
[*] -20% skill cooldown[/list][/list]

[list][*] [b]Legendary Rarity[/b][/list][list][list][*] 20% chance to deal critical (triple) damage with holy skills[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Mythical rarity:[/b][/list][list][list][*] 25% chance to deal double damage with any evolved skill[/list][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/1ff409fb630aae08d7134775addc8334f0b9d3d6.png[/img]

[u][b]3 new unique weapons[/b][/u] await you in the Desert Treasure Portal:

[h3]The Symbol of Power — Legendary Sacred Item[/h3]

Grants the [b]Faith Roll[/b] skill when equipped
[list]
[*] +30% damage dealt with the Faith Roll skill on Unusual Rarity
[*] +5% damage dealth with all skills on Rare Rarity
[*] +1 Faith Roll skill level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity
[*] +12% damage dealt with the Faith Roll skill for every 10 levels gained in the current match on Legendary Rarity
[*] +1 Assault! skill evolution level on a Mythical rarity
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/d68e0e1d6aa22ac1718bfdbf09edda722f8da178.png[/img]

[h3] The Eye of Death — Legendary Key of Death[/h3]

Grants the [b]Thread of Fate[/b] skill when equipped[list]
[*] +30% damage dealt with the Thread of Fate on Unusual Rarity
[*] +5% damage dealt with all skills on Rare Rarity
[*] +1 Thread of Fate skill level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity
[*] +2 projectiles for the Thread of Fate skill on Legendary Rarity
[*] +1 Samsara Carpet skill evolution level on Mythical Rarity
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/e4a98b2b467325d956dc28683e32a1ae25d99852.png[/img]

[h3]The Breath of God — Legendary Key of Life[/h3] 

Grants the [b]Thread of Life[/b] skill when equipped.
[list]
[*] +30% damage dealt with the Thread of Life on Unusual Rarity
[*] +5% damage dealt with all skills on Rare Rarity
[*] +1 Thread of Life skill level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity
[*] 45% larger Thread of Life skill's area of effect on Legendary Rarity
[*] +1 Samsara Carpet skill evolution level on Mythical Rarity
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/307832a36f0a5a115123a99b1070671d757bc6f1.png[/img]

[h2]New Skills[/h2]

The folk wisdom holds that a person's life is a canvas, with their every action woven onto it, creating an intricate pattern where it intersects the lifelines of others. It is also rumored that the sages of an ancient kingdom have learned to control these threads, and that their domain now lies in ruin as the result—swept away by the Sand Dunes, with evil abominations stalking through what were once prosperous cities... But who knows how much truth there is to these old tales? You should take them with a grain of salt. What we do know for sure is that Academy scientists have recently discovered two hitherto unseen skills and their evolutions. Judging by the ancient scrolls, we are dealing with:

[h3][b]The Thread of Life[/b][/h3]
Type: Offensive Skill. Element: Holy. When activated, horizontal stands of pure light stretch across the entire battlefield. Their divine power is so strong that any opponent that touches them will receive a lot of damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/bdf5f74874ca4d21f55d7d91de8de94f1e716322.png[/img]

[h3][b]The Thread of Fate[/b][/h3]
Type: Offensive Skill. Element: Spiritual. When activated, vertical stands of accursed darkness stretch across the entire battlefield. The pain of a thousand tormented souls within causes spiritual damage to any enemy unlucky enough to stand in their way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/4cf87043e2fcfc14883bd3e2620d4e42709a6604.png[/img]

[h3][b]Samsara Carpet[/b][/h3]
Type: Evolution. Element: Holy/Spiritual. Recipe: Thread of Life (Lv. 8) + Thread of Fate (Lv. 8). This evolution may look the same as any other, but the Samsara Carpet does not require any passive skills—only the two active ones. When activated, the entire battlefield will be lined with horizontal and vertical strands, covering it like a carpet and causing damage to anyone who comes into contact with them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/c5965352285f54a4249c6873db57f91ca5bf573f.png[/img]

[h2]New Weapon[/h2]

New skills work best with new weapons, right? And new weapons have already arrived in abundance to all the evil bosses of Singoru and, of course, to the Portal of the Eternal Soul, the Portal of the Scorching Sun, and the Portal of the Desert Treasures. Here, take a look:

[h3]The Key of Life.[/h3] Grants the [b]Thread of Life[/b] skill when equipped.
[list]
[*] +25% damage dealt with the Thread of Life on Unusual Rarity
[*] +4% damage dealt with all skills on rare rarity
[*] +1 Thread of Life skill level at the start of the match on Epic Rarity
[*] +6% damage dealt with all skills on Legendary Rarity
[*] +1 Samsara Carpet skill evolution level on Mythical Rarity
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/eefbe026b0a4235ca26c544d02263961f204bb1e.png[/img]
[h3]The Key of Death.[/h3] Grants the [b]Thread of Fate[/b] skill when equipped.
[list]
[*] +25% damage dealt with the Thread of Fate on Unusual Rarity
